title: Smoked Jamaican Potatoes
description: A flavorful side dish that combines the sweetness of potatoes with the smokiness of Jamaican spice.
instructions: Place the cubed potatoes on a baking sheet, drizzle with a little bit of oil, and toss to coat.
Roast the potatoes in the oven for 20 minutes, or until they start to soften.
In a small bowl, mix together the smoked spice, Jamaican sweet spice, and honey or maple syrup.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and toss them with the spice mixture until they're evenly coated.
Return the potatoes to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until they're cooked through and caramelized.
